integrity: The general argument is a self-contained proof from the definition of the diagonal Ramsey number; a small exhaustive checker verifies only the l=3 numerical specialization.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the optimal maximum of a finite spectrum for fixed existential/universal prefix lengths, but does not classify all finite spectra below that endpoint and inherits unknown exact diagonal Ramsey numbers for larger universal blocks.
title: Sharp Ramsey cutoff for Bernays–Schönfinkel graph spectra
